question: Where can I locate restaurant within 110 kilometers when heading toward Cal Aggie Flying Farmers, Davis, CA starting at John Natsoulas Gallery, Davis, CA?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%John Natsoulas Gallery%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Davis%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 ), destination_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Cal Aggie Flying Farmers%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Davis%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, start_point AS sp, destination_point AS dp WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, sp.geometry::geography, 110 * 1000) AND ( SELECT LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(sp.geometry, p.geometry)) - degrees(ST_Azimuth(sp.geometry, dp.geometry))), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(sp.geometry, p.geometry)) - degrees(ST_Azimuth(sp.geometry, dp.geometry))) ) ) <= 45;
